instruction: Can you help me increase the maximum volume limit in VLC Media Player to 200%? The default 125% is not loud enough for some of my quieter audio files.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires increasing VLC's maximum volume setting from the default 125% to 200%. The evaluator uses the existing check_qt_max_volume metric to verify that qt-max-volume is set to 200. Similar difficulty to the original - navigating VLC preferences and changing a single setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC configuration file from appropriate OS-specific paths
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses vlcrc file and checks qt-max-volume setting
Expected value (200) matches instruction requirement exactly
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement (max volume = 200%)
Appropriate postconfig: kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are persisted to disk
Robust edge case handling: defaults to '125' if setting not found, handles type conversions, catches file errors
Data flow is semantically correct: config file -> parse setting -> compare with expected value
